name: deadpan-doodles
description: Translucent pen-and-watercolor illustrations with dry humor and playfully offbeat proportions.

interface.shortDescription: Dry humor, loose pen lines, translucent watercolor.
interface.longDescription: Draw people, animals, plants, objects, and small scenes as if a child drew them carefully: uneven shape allocation, deadpan expressions, loose ink lines, and translucent washes that sometimes bleed beyond the outline. A dedicated portrait module handles likeness; fixed recipes and reference hashes help keep the workflow consistent.
defaultPrompt: Use $deadpan-doodles to draw a languid cat beside a small flower, with translucent watercolor and visibly offbeat proportions.
用 $deadpan-doodles 根据我的照片画人物 IP，比例明显反常、有冷幽默，不要太可爱。
